kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نستنبئ (form X)
# نَسْتَنْبِئُ (nastanbiʔu) /nas.tan.bi.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْبَأَ (istanbaʔa)
# نَسْتَنْبِئَ (nastanbiʔa) /nas.tan.bi.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَنْبَأَ (istanbaʔa)
# نَسْتَنْبِئْ (nastanbiʔ) /nas.tan.biʔ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَنْبَأَ (istanbaʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
